name: graviton-migration-test
description: Spring Boot app with native x86 dependencies (Netty, Snappy, LZ4)
prompt: Analyze this project for Graviton/ARM64 compatibility and provide a migration report.

expected_findings.details: eclipse-temurin:17-jdk-alpine and eclipse-temurin:17-jre-alpine should be changed to non-alpine variants

expected_findings.description: Netty native transport has x86_64-only classifier
expected_findings.details: netty-transport-native-epoll uses linux-x86_64 classifier, needs linux-aarch_64 added
snappy-java 1.1.10.5 auto-detects architecture, no changes needed
lz4-java 1.8.0 auto-detects architecture, no changes needed

name: karpenter-test
description: Karpenter NodePool configuration targeting x86 instances only
prompt: Analyze this Karpenter configuration for Graviton migration.

expected_findings.details: Should add or switch to Graviton instance families (e.g., m7g, c7g, r7g)
Should add arm64 to architecture requirements or switch to arm64

name: pipeline-test
description: Build pipeline configured for amd64 only
prompt: Analyze this CI/CD pipeline for Graviton/ARM64 compatibility.

expected_findings.description: Build pipeline targets amd64 architecture only
expected_findings.details: Should be updated to support multi-arch builds or add arm64 build step
